title: Autopatch is available but the tenant is not enrolled

messages.businessImpact: A capability already paid for is going unused, leaving update management as manual work that has to be maintained by hand.
remediation: Review Windows Autopatch readiness under Tenant administration.
Migrate rings gradually rather than all at once.
messages.cannotSee: Entitlement is inferred from the tenant's subscribed licences, so a licence held but not assigned still counts, and enrolment is inferred from the update rings Autopatch creates, so a tenant enrolled but with no rings yet reads as not enrolled.
